facts.quote: I am Hester Vane, secretary of the flower show at Combe Regis.

facts.value: the cup's winner three years running
facts.quote: Abel Crouch's marrow had won the cup three years running.
On the Saturday it was kept off the show bench, and George Pask gained the cup by that.
After dark on the Friday, Abel was at the allotments.

facts.value: wants George Pask's marrow to be the winner over Abel Crouch's marrow on the bench, and for that Abel Crouch's marrow must not be kept off the show bench
facts.quote: On the Monday Pask said to me, "I want my marrow to beat Abel's on the bench, and for that Abel's marrow must not be kept off the show bench."

facts.value: wants Abel Crouch's marrow to be the cup's winner this year, and for that Abel Crouch's marrow must not be kept off the show bench
facts.quote: On the Wednesday Mrs. Crouch said to me, "I want Abel's marrow to win the cup this year, and for that it must not be kept off the show bench."

facts.value: wants Abel Crouch's marrow to be kept off the show bench
facts.quote: On Friday morning Abel said to me, and plainly, "I want my marrow to be kept off the show bench."

facts.quote: On the Sunday Abel said to me, "It was I who spoiled my marrow at my shed."
